metadata.description: A CLI-first Claude Code plugin that audits, initializes and hardens Sentry in any repo.

plugins.name: sentry
plugins.description: Detect the repo, audit or initialize Sentry (errors, tracing, profiling, replay, logs, metrics, crons, uptime, releases, source maps, alerts, AI monitoring), apply approved changes, and prove them with a live event. CLI-first on the sentry v4 CLI.
